correctness.rationale: In char2 the gradient of Q^2 vanishes and gradient of the coordinate product forces every singularity onto a coordinate edge; nonzero a_i exclude vertices. On edge i,j the separable quadratic a_i t²+b_ij t+a_j has two distinct nonzero roots, and the local tangent cone (b_ij u+αv+βw)²+t0 vw is a smooth plane conic, hence an A1. The normalized Artin–Schreier polynomial z²+z+a_i a_j/b_ij² splits iff absolute trace vanishes. For fixed nonzero a_i, each b_ij independently permutes F_q^×, so exact profile counts are (q−1)^4(q/2−1)^s(q/2)^{6−s}. Each residue-degree-one/two ordinary node resolves into a P1 over its residue finite field, yielding (1−qT)^{−2s}(1−q²T²)^{−(6−s)} and point-count differences over all extensions. Independent explicit enumeration of all 59,049 F4 coefficient tuples and edge root counts for 64 representative masks reproduces all s counts; universal result follows from algebra, not enumeration.
